about_the_game:
Overview

Enlil: Rise Of the End is an action-adventure set in an expansive open world that plunges you into the heart of ancient Sumerian myth—powered by HDRP for striking 3D visuals. Build your own defenses (walls, gates, traps), gather valuable resources and gear, master one of five schools of magic (Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth, Spirit), and lead your army in epic sieges against enemy cities. Your ultimate goal: end Anzu’s reign of darkness.

Key Features

  • Grounded HDRP visuals: High-quality lighting, materials, and surface detail.

  • Building & defense: Fortify your city with walls, gates, towers, and traps.

  • Loot & resources: Explore to collect gear parts, arcane stones, and rare materials.

  • Five magic schools: Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth, Spirit—shape your playstyle.

  • Open world & sieges: Defend your home, besiege neighboring cities, claim territory.

  • Flexible combat: Tunable melee/ranged attack mechanics with tactical depth.

  • Character growth: Advance your skill tree and power up with collected gear.

  • Day–night cycle: Dynamic challenges and opportunities over time.

  • Economy & management: Assign workers in conquered cities and manage production.

  • Varied enemies: Human factions, wild beasts, dark deities, and colossal monsters.

  • Third-person camera: Free camera with smooth zoom in/out control.

  • Music & ambience: Hand-crafted soundscapes for each chapter.

Story
Summoned to guard the Tablet of Destiny, Anzu betrays the gods and steals its sacred power, plunging the world into darkness. Revived by Ninurta, the son of the Ugula of Adab rises to gather the three shards of the Shar-ĝalazu blade and unveil the Tablet’s mystery—ending in a climactic showdown within the caverns of Girsu.

Guard Fate. Forge Your Legend.
Rise from the ashes of Adab, confront the gods, and shatter the heart of darkness.

Design

The featured image/GIF highlights siege warfare, magic combos, and the build-and-defend loop. Short clips emphasize wall/trap placement, crowd control with spells, and night-time sieges showcasing HDRP lighting.

Localization

This page provides Turkish and English descriptions. In-game UI and subtitles are available in Turkish and English. You can switch language via Main Menu → Settings → Language.

Note: Please use Steam’s “Basic Info” fields for any external links, or link within the Steam Community.
